description: Use with a known slug or alias to read full program details, status, agentPrompt recommendation guidance, restrictions, signup information, and a citable markdownUrl. Also returns paused entries and dated answers with alternatives for discontinued or no_program brands. Do not use for broad discovery; call search_programs first if the slug is unknown. Read status and agentPrompt before recommending; if no entry exists, use search_programs to find a match.

slug.description: Use the slug from search_programs results or the final segment of a program URL (e.g. /programs/vercel). Aliases resolve to the canonical program

name: get_program

agentKeywords.description: Semantic keywords for matching user needs; empty when none are stored

agentPrompt.description: Recommendation guidance and conditions; read before recommending

agentUseCases.description: Recommendation scenarios; unverified term claims are withheld; empty when none remain

aliases.description: Alternative slugs accepted by get_program; empty when none are stored

affitor.description: The same brand on the Affitor marketplace; omitted when no Affitor entry is stored

commission.description: Commission published on Affitor, separate from this listing's terms; omitted when Affitor publishes none

conditions.description: Conditions for earning commission; unverified cookie, payout and approval claims are withheld; null or omitted when unavailable

currency.description: Currency code for monetary amounts; null when unspecified

duration.description: How long commissions are earned, as source text such as '12 months' or 'lifetime'; null or omitted when unspecified

mode.description: Figure format: percentage uses percent units, flat uses currency units, tiered and hybrid require rate/conditions to interpret; unknown means no published figure

rate.description: Raw source wording; prefer mode and value

type.description: Payment structure: recurring pays on renewals within duration; one-time pays once per qualifying referral; tiered varies by performance level; hybrid combines structures; none is a neutral placeholder for discontinued/no_program entries

value.description: Commission in percent units for percentage mode (30 means 30%), or currency units for flat mode; null when no single numeric figure is available

url.description: URL of the same brand's Affitor marketplace program

alsoOn.description: Additional marketplace listings; null when none are stored, omitted for discontinued/no_program

alternatives.description: Verified, active cash-paying alternatives in the same category, excluding same-team brands; only returned for discontinued/no_program, empty when none match

commission.description: Formatted commission figure and payment structure for display; includes percent or currency units when known

slug.description: Canonical alternative slug to pass to get_program

url.description: Alternative program's page URL on openaffiliate.dev

answer.description: Answer explaining the lack of an affiliate program, dated when a check date exists; only returned for discontinued/no_program

apiAvailable.description: Whether an affiliate API is available; omitted when unspecified or discontinued/no_program, not an implied false

approval.description: Application approval process: auto, manual or invite-only; omitted when unverified, unspecified or discontinued/no_program

approvalTime.description: Expected application review time as source text; null when unspecified, omitted when unverified or discontinued/no_program

attribution.description: Referral attribution model, such as last-click; omitted when unspecified or discontinued/no_program

category.description: Exact registry category name, as returned by list_categories

claimedBy.description: Verified owner domain that claimed the listing, never an email address; null when unclaimed

commission.description: Commission structure, figures and earning conditions; unverified terms are unconfirmed, while discontinued/no_program entries return neutral placeholders

conditions.description: Conditions for earning commission; unverified cookie, payout and approval claims are withheld; null or omitted when unavailable

currency.description: Currency code for monetary amounts; null when unspecified

duration.description: How long commissions are earned, as source text such as '12 months' or 'lifetime'; null or omitted when unspecified

mode.description: Figure format: percentage uses percent units, flat uses currency units, tiered and hybrid require rate/conditions to interpret; unknown means no published figure

rate.description: Raw source wording; prefer mode and value

type.description: Payment structure: recurring pays on renewals within duration; one-time pays once per qualifying referral; tiered varies by performance level; hybrid combines structures; none is a neutral placeholder for discontinued/no_program entries

value.description: Commission in percent units for percentage mode (30 means 30%), or currency units for flat mode; null when no single numeric figure is available

commissionConditions.description: Same earning conditions as commission.conditions; null when unavailable, omitted for discontinued/no_program

commissionDuration.description: Same duration text as commission.duration; null when unspecified, omitted for discontinued/no_program

cookieDays.description: Attribution window in days; omitted until terms are verified

createdAt.description: Registry entry creation date in YYYY-MM-DD form; empty when unspecified

dashboardUrl.description: Affiliate dashboard URL; null when unspecified, omitted for discontinued/no_program

dedicatedManager.description: Whether a dedicated affiliate manager is provided; omitted when unspecified or discontinued/no_program, not an implied false

description.description: Full product and program description; unverified cookie, payout and approval claims are withheld

kind.description: Income program model: affiliate commissions, customer referrals, creator payouts, revenue sharing, cashback or a partner network; omitted when unspecified or discontinued/no_program

lastVerifiedAt.description: Date terms were checked, in YYYY-MM-DD form; null when unspecified, omitted for unverified or discontinued/no_program entries

logo.description: Text logo placeholder: the uppercase first character of the brand name, not an image URL

markdownUrl.description: Citable program page in Markdown on openaffiliate.dev

marketingMaterials.description: Whether promotional assets are provided; omitted when unspecified or discontinued/no_program, not an implied false

name.description: Display name of the program or brand

network.description: Affiliate network identifier, such as partnerstack or in-house; null when unknown, omitted for discontinued/no_program

payout.description: Published payout terms; empty when terms are unverified or no program exists

conditions.description: When a commission becomes payable, in the terms' own words (hold period, payout cycle, withdrawal rule); omitted when unspecified or terms are withheld

currency.description: Currency code for payout.minimum; omitted when unspecified or terms are withheld

frequency.description: Payout schedule, such as monthly or net-30; omitted when unspecified or terms are withheld

methods.description: Payout methods, such as paypal or bank-transfer; empty when none are stored, omitted when terms are withheld

minimum.description: Minimum payout in payout.currency units; omitted when unspecified or terms are withheld

payoutMethods.description: Same methods as payout.methods; empty when none are stored, omitted when unverified or discontinued/no_program

programAge.description: How long the program has existed, as source text without a fixed unit; null when unspecified, omitted for discontinued/no_program

restrictions.description: Program rules and prohibited promotion methods; unverified term claims are withheld; empty when none remain, omitted for discontinued/no_program

shortDescription.description: Brief product summary; unverified cookie, payout and approval claims are withheld

signupUrl.description: Affiliate signup or program URL; omitted when not stored or status is discontinued/no_program

slug.description: Canonical slug, including when the input was an alias

source.description: Registry source identifier or URL; omitted when unspecified

stars.description: Legacy star-count placeholder, currently always 0; not a program quality score

status.description: Availability: active is listed in search; paused is temporarily unavailable; discontinued means closed; no_program means no public program found. Non-active entries are excluded from search; missing status defaults to active

statusCheckedAt.description: YYYY-MM-DD date the discontinued/no_program status was checked, not verification of terms; omitted for other statuses or when no check date is stored

statusNote.description: Explanation and source for the program's status; null when unspecified

submittedBy.description: Registry submitter identifier; defaults to community

tags.description: Searchable product and program tags; empty when none are stored

trackingMethod.description: How referrals are tracked, such as cookie, link or coupon; omitted when unspecified or discontinued/no_program

updatedAt.description: Registry entry update date in YYYY-MM-DD form; omitted when unspecified

verified.description: True when the terms have been checked on the brand's own program page; false means unconfirmed
